title: Derivative of the graph parametrization x -> (x, u(x))
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, u : R^n -> R^l and x in R^n, and suppose u is (Frechet) differentiable at x. Then the graph map G(z) := graphPoint z (u z) = (z, u(z)) in R^(n+l) is differentiable at x, and DG(x) v = graphPoint v (Du(x) v) = (v, Du(x) v) for every v in R^n.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n), DifferentiableAt ℝ u x → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x ∧ ∀ v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun z : Rn n => graphPoint z (u z)) x v = graphPoint v (fderiv ℝ u x v)
